reason: I only buy gummies or drinks because I hate swallowing pills, and this is 2 capsules every night. Even if the lab report is nice, I would not stick with it.
objection: Two capsules a day is a no for me, and $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli, which last longer and I actually enjoy taking.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or drink version at around the same price as Toplux.
